Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: After WebSurfer surfaced an authoritative Halliburton source (IR/Sustainability report) stating the company operates in “more than 70 countries” at Step 6, the Planner failed to synthesize the evidence and instead repeated essentially the same search instructions, entering a redundant loop. This reflects a failure to consolidate available information into an answer and unnecessary repetition despite sufficient, credible sources already confirming the required country count.
